newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs, pork bellies slip after mixed start.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs, pork bellies slip after mixed start.

text.p: CME hog and pork belly futures opened mixed before slipping on profit taking, traders said.

Carryover demand from recent strength in cash hogs and a firm cash belly market and strong hands in August deliveries started pork pits higher. But profit taking developed ahead of the weekend, especially after gains this week, they said.
At 0919 CDT, hogs were off 0.350 to up 0.175 cent per lb with October off 0.100 at 72.925 cents. Pork bellies were off 0.600 to 0.925 with February off most at 73.700 cents.
